evidence.section: 3.1 Initial microstructural evolution with increasing annealing temperature
evidence.quote: Figure 1 shows the XRD curves of the cold-rolled and annealed Al 0.1 CrFeCoNi HEA samples. All curves reveal an fcc structure.

evidence.section: 3.1 Initial microstructural evolution with increasing annealing temperature
evidence.quote: For the cold-rolled sample, the microstructure comprises stretched grains along the rolling direction with an average width (space between the two boundaries of the stretched grains) of ~20 µm

evidence.section: 3.1 Initial microstructural evolution with increasing annealing temperature
evidence.quote: Such a stretched-grained microstructure is retained in the 673 K-annealed sample, as shown in Fig. 2b, and indicates no occurrence of recrystallization during the 673 K annealing treatment.

attributes.morphology: mixture of stretched, partially recrystallized and fully recrystallized grains

evidence.section: 3.1 Initial microstructural evolution with increasing annealing temperature
evidence.quote: the stretched grains were partially recrystallized, which led to a heterostructured microstructure that was composed of three grain types, namely, the stretched grains (NR1), partially-recrystallized grains (NR2), and fully-recrystallize grains (R)

evidence.section: 3.1 Initial microstructural evolution with increasing annealing temperature

evidence.section: 3.1 Initial microstructural evolution with increasing annealing temperature
